title: Zesty Bitter British Sausages Toad In The Hole
description: A classic British dish featuring pre-fried sausages in a bitter and savory Yorkshire pudding batter, served with a sweet and tangy Mediterranean-inspired glaze.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper to make the Yorkshire pudding batter.
Add the pre-fried sausages to the batter and stir to coat.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake the toad in the hole for 25-30 minutes, or until the pudding is golden brown and puffed.
While the toad in the hole is baking, heat the bitter marmalade in a small saucepan over medium heat until it is warm and syrupy.
Remove the toad in the hole from the oven and brush the warm marmalade glaze over the top.
Return the toad in the hole to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and sticky.
